name: cell-ppt
description: Create editable native PowerPoint figures on Windows and macOS.

interface.longDescription: Cell_ppt uses one reconstruction pipeline on Windows and macOS. Windows draws live through COM; macOS writes editable native OOXML into a saved PPTX. WPS support is experimental.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Cell_ppt to reconstruct my uploaded scientific figure as editable native objects in the current PowerPoint slide.
